# bellreg

The goal of bellreg is to provide a set of functions to fit regression
models for count data with overdispersion using the Bell distribution.
The implemented models account for ordinary and zero-inflated regression
models under both frequentist and Bayesian approaches. Theoretical
details regarding the models implemented in the package can be found in
Castellares et al. (2018) <doi:10.1016/j.apm.2017.12.014> and Lemonte et
al. (2020) <doi:10.1080/02664763.2019.1636940>.

## Installation

You can install the development version of bellreg from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("fndemarqui/bellreg")
```

## Example

``` r
library(bellreg)

data(faults)

# ML approach:
mle <- bellreg(nf ~ lroll, data = faults, approach = "mle")
summary(mle)
#> Call:
#> bellreg(formula = nf ~ lroll, data = faults, approach = "mle")
#> 
#> Coefficients:
#>               Estimate     StdErr z.value   p.value    
#> (Intercept) 0.98524220 0.33219474  2.9659  0.003018 ** 
#> lroll       0.00190934 0.00049004  3.8963 9.766e-05 ***
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
#> 
#> logLik =   AIC = 181.9228

# Bayesian approach:
bayes <- bellreg(nf ~ lroll, data = faults, approach = "bayes", refresh = FALSE)
summary(bayes)
#> Call:
#> bellreg(formula = nf ~ lroll, data = faults, approach = "bayes", 
#>     refresh = FALSE)
#> 
#> Prior specifications: 
#> intercept ~ normal(0, 10)
#> beta ~ normal(0, 2.5)
#> 
#> Summary of the posterior distribution: 
#>               mean     sd   2.5%    50%  97.5%    n_eff   Rhat
#> (Intercept) 0.9934 0.3320 0.3328 0.9947 1.6252 2097.753 1.0025
#> lroll       0.0019 0.0005 0.0009 0.0019 0.0029 2337.698 1.0022
#> 
#> Inference for Stan model: bellreg.
#> 4 chains, each with iter=2000; warmup=1000; thin=1; 
#> post-warmup draws per chain=1000, total post-warmup draws=4000.
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`AIC(`*`<bellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/AIC.bellreg.md)
  : Akaike information criterion

- [`AIC(`*`<zibellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/AIC.zibellreg.md)
  : Akaike information criterion for zibellreg objects

- [`dbell()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/Belldist.md)
  [`pbell()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/Belldist.md)
  [`qbell()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/Belldist.md)
  [`rbell()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/Belldist.md)
  : Probability function, distribution function, quantile function and
  random generation for the Bell distribution with parameter theta.

- [`anova(`*`<zibellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/anova.zibellreg.md)
  : anova method for zibellreg models

- [`bell()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/bell.md) :
  Family Objects for Models

- [`bellreg-package`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/bellreg-package.md)
  [`BellReg`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/bellreg-package.md)
  : The 'bellreg' package.

- [`bellreg()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/bellreg.md)
  : Bell regression model

- [`cells`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/cells.md) :
  Cells data set

- [`coef(`*`<bellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/coef.bellreg.md)
  : Estimated regression coefficients for the bellreg model

- [`coef(`*`<zibellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/coef.zibellreg.md)
  : Estimated regression coefficients for zibellreg model

- [`confint(`*`<bellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/confint.bellreg.md)
  : Confidence intervals for the regression coefficients

- [`confint(`*`<zibellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/confint.zibellreg.md)
  : Confidence intervals for the regression coefficients

- [`dtpois()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/dtpois.md)
  [`ptpois()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/dtpois.md)
  [`qtpois()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/dtpois.md)
  [`rtpois()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/dtpois.md)
  : The Truncated Poisson Distribution

- [`recover_data(`*`<bellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/emmeans-bellreg-helpers.md)
  [`recover_data(`*`<zibellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/emmeans-bellreg-helpers.md)
  :

  Support Functions for emmeans

- [`extract_log_lik()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/extract_log_lik.md)
  : Extract pointwise log-likelihood from a Stan model for a bellreg
  model

- [`faults`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/faults.md) :
  Faults data set

- [`fitted(`*`<bellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/fitted.bellreg.md)
  : Extract Model Fitted Values

- [`logLik(`*`<bellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/logLik.bellreg.md)
  : Extract Log-Likelihood from a Fitted Model

- [`logLik(`*`<zibellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/logLik.zibellreg.md)
  : Extract Log-Likelihood from a Fitted Model

- [`model.matrix(`*`<zibellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/model.matrix.zibellreg.md)
  : Construct Design Matrices for zibellreg models

- [`print(`*`<summary.bellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/print.summary.bellreg.md)
  : Print the summary.bellreg output

- [`print(`*`<summary.zibellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/print.summary.zibellreg.md)
  : Print the summary.zibellreg output

- [`prior_spec()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/prior_spec.md)
  : Prior specification

- [`summary(`*`<bellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/summary.bellreg.md)
  : Summary for the bellreg model

- [`summary(`*`<zibellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/summary.zibellreg.md)
  : Summary for the zibellreg model

- [`tidy(`*`<bellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/tidy.bellreg.md)
  : Tidy a bellreg object

- [`tidy(`*`<zibellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/tidy.zibellreg.md)
  : Tidy a zibellreg object

- [`vcov(`*`<bellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/vcov.bellreg.md)
  : Variance-covariance matrix for a bellreg model

- [`vcov(`*`<zibellreg>`*`)`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/vcov.zibellreg.md)
  : Covariance of the regression coefficients

- [`zibellreg()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/bellreg/reference/zibellreg.md)
  : ZiBell regression model
